item.name: Factset Retrieve Streetaccount Headlines for Given View

variable.description: (Required) view id of the view to return headlines for

request.description: This endpoint allows you to pull all headlines produced by StreetAccount for a saved view. The full story body will be returned by the data set. Views can be created via the Create Views endpoint.
